series.summary: On the rooftop, Rentaro refuses to let either soulmate die. Falling into a desperate dogeza, he confesses his genuine love to both Hakari and Karane, proposing to date them both—a plea they shockingly accept.

segments.voiceover_text: With two innocent lives hanging in the balance, Rentaro meets Hakari and Karane on the rooftop at dawn.
Both girls wait with racing hearts, anxiously bracing for his final decision between them.
Refusing to let either girl die, Rentaro drops into a desperate dogeza, begging to date them both simultaneously.
Though stunned by his shameless proposal, both girls are deeply moved by his fierce honesty and boundless devotion.
Blushing through their tears, Hakari and Karane accept his outrageous plea, officially launching Rentaro's legendary journey with his first two loving girlfriends.
